sections.name: Colour: plain-background text cards
sections.use: Which colour pairing feels like Vale. Same words, same Helvetica, same hard cut, same small details (label, hairline, sun mark, grain). Only the colours change.

sections.name: Motion: how the text arrives
sections.use: Same monochrome card and words. Only the entrance changes, from Tom's hard cut to smooth, snappy, filmic and glitchy accents.

sections.name: Type: big statements
sections.use: Same monochrome card and hard cut. Only the typography changes: Helvetica weights, a tall condensed cut, the repeated stack from your Pinterest, and a handwritten note.

sections.name: Sounds
sections.use: Each sound plays on a short animation of the thing it's for, landing at 0.8 s. Open one full size to hear it. Synthesised from scratch in code (no AI sound generator is connected yet).

sections.name: Captions
sections.use: Same footage, same words, same position (just under the chin, clear of the shirt logo). Only the caption style changes. Open one to hear it with sound.

cards.label: Monochrome
cards.desc: Warm off-black with warm white, the logo cream on the key word, film grain. From your VALE board.

cards.label: Analog cream
cards.desc: Cream paper with near-black type and the key word in ochre. From your Creative board.

cards.label: Kraft and brick
cards.desc: Kraft paper with near-black type and the key word in brick red. Warmer, more retro print.

cards.label: Dusty blue
cards.desc: Dusty blue type on pale grey-white, one colour only. From "IT'S ALREADY YOURS".

cards.label: Hard cut
cards.desc: Appears in one frame, no movement. Tom Noske's cut scene.

cards.label: Smooth rise
cards.desc: Each word rises 28px and fades in, 90 ms apart, on a soft ease (520 ms). Calm and clear for teaching.

cards.label: Snappy mask
cards.desc: Each word slides up from behind its own mask, 60 ms apart, on a sharp ease (240 ms). Fast and clean.

cards.label: Filmic focus
cards.desc: The line pulls into focus: 24px blur to sharp, 104% to 100% scale, slight exposure lift (800 ms), then a slow drift.

cards.label: Glitch accent
cards.desc: Cuts in with a 4-frame RGB split and sliced offsets, then sits perfectly still. For key moments only.

cards.label: Helvetica bold, lowercase
cards.desc: Helvetica Neue Bold 150px, lowercase, tight tracking. Closest to Tom Noske.

cards.label: Helvetica medium, sentence case
cards.desc: Helvetica Neue Medium 120px, sentence case, a calmer more editorial voice.

cards.label: Condensed, uppercase
cards.desc: Helvetica Neue Condensed Black 210px, uppercase, stacked tall. Poster energy from your BRAND board.

cards.label: Repeated stack
cards.desc: The line repeats seven times, growing each row in Condensed Bold, the last row running off the edges. From "IT'S ALREADY YOURS".

cards.label: Bold plus handwritten note
cards.desc: Helvetica Bold line with a handwritten aside and a hand-drawn underline in logo cream.

cards.label: Soft click
cards.desc: A short tick with a high ping, on a word cutting in. For card cuts and small UI moments.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r1-e1.wav

cards.label: Soft whoosh
cards.desc: A filtered air sweep that peaks as a cream panel wipes across. For transitions and fast moves.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r1-e2.wav

cards.label: Paper slide
cards.desc: Soft paper friction with a quiet tap as a card lands. For cards and notes sliding in.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r1-e3.wav

cards.label: Punchy hit
cards.desc: A deep 50 Hz thump with a crack on top, on a big word slamming in with a 3-frame shake. For big moments only.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r1-e4.wav

cards.label: Film click
cards.desc: A shutter-style double click with a flash frame as the picture snaps into focus. Analog, filmic.
cards.source: Synthesised in code by Claude / r1-e5.wav

cards.label: Tom: 1 to 2 bold words
cards.desc: Helvetica Neue Bold 96px, lowercase, white, two words at a time, soft shadow. Closest to Tom Noske.

cards.label: Gannon: tiny
cards.desc: Same as Tom's, but small: 46px. Quieter, lets the picture breathe.

cards.label: Phrase with spoken words lit
cards.desc: Three to four words at a time, 80px bold; words not said yet sit at 40% white.

cards.label: Tom plus one cream word
cards.desc: Tom's caption, with the key word (“better”) in your logo cream.

cards.label: Sentence case, medium
cards.desc: Helvetica Neue Medium 72px in sentence case, three to four words. More editorial, less punchy.
